claims: Continue renal replacement therapy (CRRT) for acute kidney injury with severe azotemia, hyperphosphatemia, and metabolic acidosis.
Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings, weaning toward spontaneous breathing as tolerated.
Continue norepinephrine infusion to maintain adequate mean arterial pressure.
Monitor arterial blood gases and lactate to assess acid-base status and perfusion.
Monitor platelet count and coagulation parameters for thrombocytopenia and bleeding risk.
Monitor serum potassium and magnesium and replace as needed to maintain normal levels.
Monitor blood glucose closely and continue insulin therapy to manage hyperglycemia.
Monitor for rhabdomyolysis complications (acute kidney injury, hyperkalemia, hyperphosphatemia) with serial creatine kinase and renal function tests.
Perform daily sedation interruption and delirium assessment (CAM-ICU) to guide sedation management.
Obtain blood cultures and administer broad-spectrum antibiotics for suspected infection given leukocytosis and fever.
